content:
Financial calculation logic failed due to incorrect active lab resolution and misapplied shipper cost formulas.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a calculated value of 369.2 versus an expected 6276.4, while test_totals_and_decision showed a margin discrepancy of 26185.96 against 1090.76. Errors stem from failing to filter 'approved' overrides with the highest 'rev' and incorrect application of 'runs_per_year' (26 for 14-day, 13 for 28-day) to 'shipper_cost_usd'. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because currency values lacked comma-separated formatting in the final markdown output.
